name: Dodgeball Duel
hook: Rush the line, throw, dodge, catch to send them out.
how: Race to the five balls on the middle line, then throw at the other team. Get hit and you're out to the bench; press Catch right as a ball reaches you and the thrower is out instead. Last team standing wins the round; first to three rounds wins.
controls: WASD or arrows to run, aim with the mouse, click or Space to throw, Shift or right-click to catch, or a thumb stick with Throw and Catch buttons
uses: One player's browser keeps the balls, the rounds and who is out; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Most players knocked out, for every player.
Bots fill every empty spot, so it's always at least 4 against 4: they grab balls, throw, dodge and sometimes catch.
Every player and every ball in flight show up on all screens at once; a ball that reaches you is decided on your screen.
ideas: Add a golden ball that knocks out two players
When you catch a ball, bring a teammate back from the bench
Make the court shrink as the round goes on
